SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(s.AdmEmail1) AS AvgScoreWrite,
    s.Phone AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.[2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status]) AS AvgScoreWrite,
    s.Phone
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School Code
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.[2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status]) AS AvgScore,
    s.Phone
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.School_Code
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    s.CharterNum
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01';

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    ss.AvgScrWrite AS AverageWritingScore,
    s.CharterNum AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01');

SELECT 
    s.School AS School_Name,
    ss.AvgScrWrite AS Avg_Write_Score,
    s.CharterNum AS Communication_Number
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON f.CDSCode = SUBSTR(ss.cds, 3)
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    (f.`OpenDate` > '1991-12-31' OR f.`ClosedDate` < '2000-01-01');

    s.School,
